search_description: Type at least 2 characters to search names, paths, specs, changes, and project docs.
search_start_typing: Start typing to search the workspace.
project_selector_description: Switch to a different project or add a new one.
project_selector_unavailable_stores: Store discovery is unavailable. Registered Stores are not listed.
dashboard_store_discovery_unavailable: Store "{storeId}" cannot be resolved because Store discovery is unavailable.
dashboard_store_not_found: Store "{storeId}" was not found in the local Store catalog.
dashboard_store_unavailable_link: See the OpenSpec Stores Guide for details.
add_project_description: Browse for a repository that already contains an openspec/ folder.
add_project_init_hint: Need a new project? Install OpenSpec and run openspec init in the repository first.
add_project_invalid_project_guidance: This directory is not initialized for OpenSpec yet. Run openspec init in the repository root, then try adding it again.
empty_project_description: OpenSpec WebUI only lists repositories that are already initialized with OpenSpec.
empty_project_init_hint: Install OpenSpec, run openspec init in the repository you want to work with, then add that directory here.
settings_description: Theme, language, command, and version settings
settings_language_description: Choose the interface language for application UI.
settings_language_independence: This changes only OpenSpec WebUI. It does not edit the active project's `openspec/config.yaml` or determine the language of generated artifacts.
settings_language_artifact_description: Artifact language is configured separately in each OpenSpec project's context.
settings_language_existing_project: For an existing project, add language guidance to `context` in `openspec/config.yaml`.
settings_language_structural_keywords: OpenSpec structural headings and the normative keywords `SHALL` and `MUST` remain in English.
settings_language_new_project_caption: New projects: copy this initialization example. It does not update the active project.
settings_theme_description: Choose the color theme for the interface.
settings_explorer_description: Control whether single-click in the Explorer opens a reusable preview tab or a normal confirmed tab.
settings_enable_preview_tabs_description: On by default. When enabled, single-click reuses one preview tab. Use Ctrl+Click or the item context menu to open a regular tab.
settings_tools_description: OpenSpec integrations configured for this repository. Run openspec init to add or remove integrations.
settings_tools_init_command_caption: Re-run openspec init in the active repository to add or remove integrations.
settings_tools_no_active_project: No active project. Select a project to see the openspec init command for its repository.
settings_tools_no_integrations: No integrations detected for this repository. Run openspec init to set up tool integrations.
tool_reference_description: Compare OpenSpec's pinned definitions with a non-exhaustive snapshot of Shared Agent Skills research.
tool_reference_error: The tool reference could not be loaded.
tool_reference_search_placeholder: Search name, id, path, or classification
tool_reference_official_intro: This table is copied from the pinned OpenSpec tool definitions. It does not describe installed applications.
tool_reference_shared_intro: The output path is shared, but the selected OpenSpec target determines the invocation syntax.
tool_reference_codex_rule: If Codex is included, select codex explicitly. A Codex-led tree can also serve slash-style clients; an agents-only tree is not a Codex setup.
tool_reference_shared_disclaimer: This is a non-exhaustive research snapshot, not a compatibility test. Missing tools carry no conclusion, and listed tools may not have been reproduced by the WebUI maintainers.
tool_reference_mode_detail_native_projec: The cited research reports repository-local shared-path discovery.
tool_reference_mode_detail_native_global: The cited research reports global shared-path discovery only.
tool_reference_mode_detail_configurable: Requires adding the shared path to the client configuration.
tool_reference_mode_detail_import: Requires importing, copying, or linking the skills into the client's native location.
tool_reference_mode_detail_format_only: Format support does not establish shared-path discovery.
tool_reference_mode_detail_unverified: Available sources are conflicting or incomplete; no compatibility conclusion is made.
settings_commands_description: Toggle which workflow shortcuts should appear in workspace and change command rows.
settings_validation_description: Configure how validation runs from the Validation panel.
settings_validation_strict_description: Run validation with --strict. This remains enabled by default for full OpenSpec checks.
settings_validation_auto_run_description: Automatically run validation when the Validation panel opens for an active project with no current result.
settings_validation_concurrency_descript: Optional positive integer passed as --concurrency <n>. Leave blank to omit it.
settings_versions_description: Check installed and latest versions for OpenSpec WebUI and the OpenSpec CLI.
settings_versions_webui_description: Representative npm global-install update path for the WebUI package.
settings_versions_openspec_description: Representative npm global-install update path for the OpenSpec CLI package.
settings_versions_post_update_descriptio: After upgrading the OpenSpec CLI, run this command in each registered project to refresh generated instructions, skills, and commands.
settings_versions_project_unknown_hint: Unknown means the project's generated version could not be detected — run `openspec update` in the project to check.
settings_expanded_commands_disabled: Expanded command availability could not be loaded from the local OpenSpec CLI, so these controls are disabled.
settings_command_desc_propose: Start a new change with all planning artifacts generated in one step.
settings_command_desc_explore: Open a thinking session to investigate ideas before creating a change.
settings_command_desc_apply: Work through the change's task list, writing code and running tests.
settings_command_desc_sync: Merge the change's delta specs into the main specs without archiving.
settings_command_desc_archive: Finalize a completed change and move it to the archive directory.
settings_command_desc_update: Revise a change's planning artifacts and keep them coherent
settings_command_desc_new: Create an empty change scaffold; generate artifacts later with continue or ff.
settings_command_desc_continue: Generate the next planning artifact in the dependency chain.
settings_command_desc_ff: Generate all remaining planning artifacts in one pass.
settings_command_desc_verify: Validate that the implementation matches the change's planning artifacts.
settings_command_desc_bulk_archive: Archive multiple changes at once, resolving spec conflicts automatically.
settings_commands_config_profile_caption: Open the interactive global workflow selector. Run `openspec update` in your project afterwards to apply the selection.
settings_commands_icon_unavailable_aria: Not available in your OpenSpec workflows
dashboard_validation_not_run_description: Open Validation to run the latest checks.
dashboard_validation_failed_description: The latest validation run found failures.
dashboard_validation_unknown_description: Validation status is unavailable right now.
dashboard_active_changes_description: Ask your AI to propose a change. Use Next Step commands to continue ongoing work.
dashboard_recent_activity_description: Newest change and spec updates across the workspace.
dashboard_invalid_config_description: config.yaml could not be parsed, so structured planning data is unavailable. Review the errors and raw file content below.

dashboard_legacy_present_description: project.md is legacy. OpenSpec planning uses config.yaml.
dashboard_ai_context_description: Included in every OpenSpec planning request.
dashboard_workflow_schema_description: Default workflow schema declared in config.yaml.
dashboard_legacy_doc_description: AI planning does not rely on this file. Review it only for unmigrated legacy context.

validation_non_navigable: This item is visible for review but does not open a spec or change tab.
